bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to veterans affairs; appropriating money for sports activities for the children of military personnel and veterans.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. [+APPROPRIATION; UNITED HEROES LEAGUE. +]

[+$100,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of veterans affairs for a grant to United Heroes League, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization based in Hastings, Minnesota, to fund sports experiences, equipment, camps, and related activities for the children of military personnel and veterans. This is a onetime appropriation. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to veterans affairs; appropriating money for sports activities for the children of military personnel and veterans.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; UNITED HEROES LEAGUE.

$100,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of veterans affairs for a grant to United Heroes League, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization based in Hastings, Minnesota, to fund sports experiences, equipment, camps, and related activities for the children of military personnel and veterans. This is a onetime appropriation.
additions: $100,000 in fiscal year 2027 is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of veterans affairs for a grant to United Heroes League, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization based in Hastings, Minnesota, to fund sports experiences, equipment, camps, and related activities for the children of military personnel and veterans. This is a onetime appropriation.
